objects.name: Analytic 1908
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol write to a parameter/setpoint register where the written value falls outside the documented safe operating range, or where the write originates from a source not in the approved write-source list, correlated with subsequent historian tag drift. Documented precedent: FrostyGoop directly modified Modbus holding register values on ENCO heating controllers in Lviv, Ukraine, causing a two-day remediation outage. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
